_readme: PINNED lens distortion models — the AUTHORITY for what the undistort stage warps with. install_lens_model.sh installs from here; lens_preflight.py --require-profile asserts the live lensfun DB still matches. Keyed '<lensfun model>@<focal mm>' because a model is a property of the LENS AND FOCAL, not of a dataset.
_why_this_file_exists: A fitted model is a MEASURED CONSTANT, not a step to re-run. Re-fitting is how you MAKE one; it is not how you reproduce one — measured 2026-07-23 (887eb00), the identical procedure on the identical frames under a different Hugin build returned coefficients 3.9% apart in a and 30.6% apart in c. So the coefficients themselves are the durable artifact and must be tracked. Before this file the shipped model lived ONLY as a hardcoded literal in install_lens_model.sh and as bytes in a machine-local lensfun DB that `lensfun-update-data` overwrites — nothing a clone could reconstruct, so no contributor could rebuild the optics every product in web/results was warped with.
_how_to_add_one: Fit it (scripts/darktable/fit_lens_model.sh <session> <set> ...), read qa_work/lens_fit.json, then add an entry here with its provenance and install it. A fresh fit is a CANDIDATE; it becomes the shipped model only by being pinned here, and swapping a shipped model is a declared delta judged on star_stations + seqtilt (never on the fit's own residual).

Nikkor Z 24-70mm f/4 S@70.status: SHIPPED — the model every july14/july23/july31 product built to date was warped with. (An earlier draft of this field called that render 'git-tagged july14-all5-cov25frame-approved'. It is not: `git tag --list` is EMPTY — the repo has never created an approval tag, though README, datasets/README and serve.py all treat one as the approval record.)

fitted.from: july14/set-01's own frames, between-frame star correspondences
fitted.method: Siril calibrate/stretch -> Hugin cpfind/cpclean/staged autooptimiser, hfov pinned at the solved value
fitted.rig: the RETIRED arm64 box — hugin version NOT RECORDED, which is the gap that made this unregenerable
fitted.record: none — the fit wrote no lens_fit.json; this entry is reconstructed from the coefficients that were hardcoded in install_lens_model.sh at 0c967a9 and installed in the live DB

Nikkor Z 24-70mm f/4 S@70.why_not_regenerable: Re-running the documented fit on the same frames with this rig's hugin-tools 2025.0.1 returns a=0.0033627 b=0.0149465 c=0.0005744 (887eb00) — a=-3.9%, c=+30.6%. The fit is toolchain-sensitive and the toolchain that produced these numbers is gone. It does not need to be regenerable: it is pinned here as data and installed from here, which is how a measured constant is reproduced.
Nikkor Z 24-70mm f/4 S@70.accepted_by: full-depth A/B vs the lensfun community profile: centre station 5.30 -> 3.67 px, all-station spread 1.70 -> 0.52 px, seqtilt truncated-mean FWHM 3.27 -> 3.06 px (0c967a9, 4b77ce1)

x86_refit_2026-07-23.status: CANDIDATE, not shipped — but MEASURED EQUIVALENT to the incumbent on a real stack (2026-08-05)
x86_refit_2026-07-23.differs_from_shipped: 0.468 px max / 0.344 px area-weighted RMS displacement, 0.2 px at r=0.9 where the correction is ~12 px
x86_refit_2026-07-23.note: Interchangeable with the shipped model on this data, so the choice is free and is made on REPRODUCIBILITY. The incumbent stays shipped because every existing product used it and swapping buys nothing measurable. The value of this result is the other direction: a rig that cannot install the pinned incumbent can re-derive an equivalent model from its own frames and lose nothing measurable.
x86_refit_2026-07-23.ab_result: 54-frame A/B on july14/set-01, one knob, everything else identical: all 9 drift-axis stations within |0.02| px majFWHM, roundness within 0.007, seqtilt truncated-mean 3.03 vs 3.03, off-axis 0.21 vs 0.20 px. NEITHER arm shows the paraxial band (centre sits at the perpendicular-station level in both). The 0.468 px coefficient difference does not reach the product. Ledger: datasets/july14/experiments.jsonl lens_model_incumbent_vs_x86refit; stations in datasets/july14/set-01/qa_work/star_stations_ab{A,B}_*.json
